vpn.name: Net Present Value
vpn.description: NPV represents the difference between the present value of cash inflows and outflows over a period of time.
vpn.interpretation: NPV > 0: The project generates value and is acceptable

tir.name: Internal Rate of Return
tir.description: IRR is the discount rate that makes the NPV of a project equal to zero.
tir.interpretation: IRR > MARR: The project is profitable

bc.name: Benefit/Cost Ratio
bc.description: Compares the present value of benefits with the present value of project costs.

payback.name: Payback Period
payback.description: Time required to recover the initial investment through project cash flows.

whydiscount.title: Why Discount Cash Flows?
whydiscount.description: Money received in the future is worth less than money received today due to the time value of money. Discounting converts future cash flows to their present value equivalent, allowing for meaningful comparison of cash flows occurring at different times. The discount rate reflects the opportunity cost of capital and the risk associated with the investment.

tmar.title: MARR Configuration
tmar.subtitle: Define the Minimum Acceptable Rate of Return
tmar.formulaDescription: Fisher relation: combining real return and inflation
tmar.formulaRealGain: Real Return (i) = Risk-free Rate + Risk Premium
tmar.rule: TMAR combines real return (i) with inflation (f) using the multiplicative Fisher equation

tir.viable: The project IS PROFITABLE. IRR exceeds the required MARR.
tir.notViable: The project IS NOT PROFITABLE. IRR is less than MARR.
tir.formulaDescription: The rate that makes NPV equal to zero, found iteratively

npv.title: NPV vs Discount Rate
npv.description: IRR is where the curve crosses zero

method.title: Methodology
method.description: The Newton-Raphson method is an iterative algorithm for finding roots of functions. For IRR, we seek the rate r where NPV(r) = 0.

details.title: Detailed Iteration Steps
details.description: Expand each iteration to see the mathematical operations
details.step1: Step 1: Calculate NPV at current rate

final.title: Final Interpretation
final.description: The Internal Rate of Return of {irr}% exceeds the minimum acceptable rate of return (TMAR) of {tmar}%. This indicates the project generates sufficient returns to justify the investment risk. The project should be accepted.
final.margin: The IRR provides a safety margin of {margin}% above the required return, offering protection against estimation errors and unforeseen circumstances.

benefitCost.marginal: The project is MARGINAL. Benefits barely cover costs.
benefitCost.formulaDescription: Present value of benefits divided by present value of costs.
